paragraphs: By way of introduction, my name is Joshua Chappell. My intent is to apply for the Insurance Representative at [Company]. I feel I have a lot of immediate value I can bring to your organization.

This role rewards people who set high goals and work their plan without close supervision. That is how I have worked for six years as the owner of Lightbox Digital. I generated my own leads, built lasting relationships with realtors, home developers, and executives, and held 5.0-star reviews for over a full year. I set revenue goals, tracked my numbers weekly, and followed through. I also hold a Master's in Marketing, so I can build and execute the kind of marketing plan this position calls for.
I appreciate that you value high goals, persistence, and professional communication; these are all values that I strive to emulate.
Thank you for taking the time out of your busy day to read my letter. I look forward to the opportunity of doing an interview with you.

reference.jd_text:
# Job Description Reference — Insurance Representative (Phoenix, AZ)

## Application Details
- **Company:** Not named in the posting text — job ID 406813, location code "AZ - PHOENIX AZ - 1A", category Sales.
- **Role:** Insurance Representative
- **Location:** Phoenix, AZ
- **Structure:** Reports to a Managing Representative, Associate Director, or Managing Director. Weekly and annual objectives set with the supervisor.

## Key Duties
- Write new quality life and health business.
- Conserve existing business and serve policy owners.
- Hit weekly/annual objectives: applications, placements, annualized premium increase, PFP interviews, QLCs, persistency, lapse limits.
- Create and execute action plans and an annual Marketing Plan with supervisor approval.
- Work independently, including evenings and weekends.
- Drive net premium growth for the assigned agency.

## Qualifications
- High school diploma required; business-related bachelor's preferred (marketing, business admin, management).
- 1–3 years insurance sales preferred, **not required**.
- **Life and health insurance license required.**
- Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.
- High goals, persistence, urgency, willingness to commit long hours, professional communication.
